spine.active_goal: PR #9 is MERGED as main beca874, closing criterion 4 in full. One agent-doable criterion remains (5: re-scan merged main). Criteria 2 and 3 are human-only - Build A stays INERT until the runbook's Sections 2-5 are applied by hand on GitHub.
spine.next_step: USER INSTRUCTION for the fresh session: proceed with the agent-doable work AND in parallel clearly explain each human-only task plus the end goal, written for a reader with minimal domain knowledge. Agent-doable: (1) re-run the no-baseline full-repo scan against merged main beca874 to close criterion 5; (2) diagnose main's 20 red tests - is the hardcoded macOS path only a test artifact, or a real portability bug that silently drops the preflight on Linux? Human-only: runbook Sections 2-5.
open_risks: main's test job is STILL RED at beca874: 20 failures (18 BOUNDARY PREFLIGHT, 2 guardrail). Proven pre-existing by diffing sorted failing-test-name sets against a pristine origin/main worktree. PR #9 added none. Owner: mitosis-preflight-hardening.

THE 20 RED TESTS MAY NOT BE A TEST ARTIFACT. The prompt CI emits carries a hardcoded /Users/satanshumishra/.claude/... path and OMITS the preflight instruction on Linux. Whether the engine degrades safely is UNVERIFIED - the merge-boundary check may run nowhere but the author's laptop.

.githooks/pre-commit runs the full suite, so while main is red NO commit lands anywhere without --no-verify. Merge commit 45f988e needed it. A guard bypassed by routine is a guard removed - fixing the suite is what restores it.

Build A is INERT and unchanged. Re-verified after the merge: the rulesets endpoint returns 0 and branch protection is empty. The lock is built and merged; it was never fitted to the door. Only Sections 2-5 change this.

0052 is DISCHARGED by 0070. The blocker was branch STALENESS, not an owed bump: origin/main already pinned d9f73571 via PR #6. A fresh fetch canonicalizes to that same hash and security is GREEN on beca874.

Criterion 5 is deliberately UNCHECKED. Its receipt (exit 0, 0 findings, 0 errors) was measured on the predicted merge result, not on merged main. Re-run against beca874 to close it honestly rather than by inference.

NEW: .claude/hooks/secret-scanner.sh has a python3 shebang but a .sh name, so semgrep parses it as bash and fails its ENTIRE body. None of the 243 Python rules apply to the repo's own blocking secret-scanner, and the scan still exits 0 so the gap is invisible.

PartialParsing is now 15 warnings across 9 files (was 9 across 8); the merged tree adds block-destructive-bash.sh. Regions stay UNSCANNED and CI shares the blind spot. They surface only under --verbose.
The suite is ~1540 tests, NOT the 1217 previously recorded - that count predated the merge of origin/main. Re-measure rather than trusting any recorded number.

Per 0071 the merge resolved two nosemgrep pragma lines toward the bare directive, OVERWRITING a human's same-line rewrite from PR #6 at live-inject.mjs:233 and live.mjs:216. Now on main. A one-line revert if the user disagrees.
0047 is still UNENFORCED and PR #9 proved it: main shows #9 as a single SQUASHED commit. Disable squash and rebase repo-side so the merge button can only produce merge commits.

Pre-existing and still NOT fixed: flagHasReachableTruePath's env probe has no left boundary, so `myprocess.env.X_ENABLED` returns true and lintFlags SKIPS the flag. Fails in the suppressing direction.

The security review independently recommends vendoring the canonical p/default content, which this thread had scoped OUT. A hash-with-no-content pin cannot diff old rules against new, and drift recurred within 8 days. User call.
fix/ledger-lint-boundary-guards and its worktree are merged and prunable. Squash-merge means `git branch --merged` will not list the branch. Cleanup is destructive; offered, NOT performed.
pr-create rejects a provenance model string carrying a bracketed context suffix (model=claude-opus-5[1m] was refused). Use the bare model id.
